rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: मेरी अचार की बरनी कहाँ गई? तीस साल से उसी ताक पर रखी थी!
rows.text: Where is my pickle jar gone? It was kept on that same shelf for thirty whole years!
rows.back_en: Where did my pickle jar go? It was kept on that exact same shelf for thirty whole years!

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: माँजी, मैंने उसे हाथ भी नहीं लगाया। सच्ची कसम!
rows.text: Maa-ji, I did not even touch it at all. Swear on God, promise!
rows.back_en: Mother, I didn't even touch it at all. I swear to God, promise!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: हाँ हाँ, बरनी को पंख लग गए होंगे। रात को उड़ के तीर्थ यात्रा पर चली गई।
rows.text: Yes yes, wings must have grown on that jar! Flew away in the night for a holy pilgrimage!
rows.back_en: Yes, yes, wings must have grown on that jar! It flew away in the night on a pilgrimage!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: हैलो फ़ॉलोअर्स! लाइव देखिए, सास-बहू महायुद्ध, एपिसोड वन!
rows.text: Hello followers! Watch live, mother-in-law versus daughter-in-law war, episode one!
rows.back_en: Hello followers! Watch live, mother-in-law versus daughter-in-law war, episode one!

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <gasp> नेहा, फ़ोन बंद कर! पूरा मोहल्ला देख लेगा!
rows.text: <gasp> Neha, switch off the phone only! Whole neighbourhood will see it!
rows.back_en: <gasp> Neha, just turn off the phone! The whole neighborhood will see it!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: भैया, पूरा मोहल्ला नहीं देख रहा। <short pause> सिर्फ़ तीन लोग देख रहे हैं।
rows.text: Bhaiya, whole colony is not watching. <short pause> Exactly three people are watching, yaar.
rows.back_en: Brother, the whole neighborhood isn't watching. <short pause> Exactly three people are watching, guys.

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: पर मेरा सीसीटीवी सब देख रहा है! सब रिकॉर्ड हो रहा है!
rows.text: But my CCTV is watching everything! Everything is getting recorded!
rows.back_en: But my CCTV is watching everything! Everything is being recorded!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: महेश, तू बता। तेरी माँ सही है या तेरी बीवी?
rows.text: Tell me, Mahesh. Who is right, your mother or your wife?
rows.back_en: Tell me, Mahesh. Who is right, your mother or your wife?

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: माँ... मैं... <laugh> आज मौसम कितना अच्छा है ना?
rows.text: Ma... I... <laugh> Today weather is so pleasant, no?
rows.back_en: Mom... I... <laugh> The weather is so pleasant today, isn't it?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: बस! ऑर्डर! ऑर्डर!
rows.text: Stop! Order! Order!
rows.back_en: Stop! Order! Order!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: रोज़-रोज़ का झगड़ा बहुत हो गया। आज इस घर में अदालत लगेगी!
rows.text: Enough of this daily-daily fighting! Today court will be held inside this house!
rows.back_en: Enough of this daily fighting! Today court will be held inside this house!

rows.speaker: TITLE
rows.hi: Ghar Ki Adalat — The Family Court
rows.text: Family Court — Ghar Ki Adalat
rows.back_en: Family Court — Home Court

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: ये स्टील की थाली मेरा हथौड़ा है। ये दादाजी का चश्मा। और ये सोफ़ा, गवाह का कटघरा!
rows.text: This steel plate is my judge's hammer. These are Dadaji's spectacles. And this sofa is the witness box!
rows.back_en: This steel plate is my judge's gavel. These are Grandfather's glasses. And this sofa is the witness stand!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: दादाजी मंदिर गए हैं। <short pause> उनका चश्मा अदालत ने ज़ब्त कर लिया है।
rows.text: Dadaji went to the temple. <short pause> The court has confiscated his spectacles!
rows.back_en: Grandfather went to the temple. <short pause> The court has confiscated his glasses!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <laugh> वाह री जज साहिबा! आज सीरियल टीवी पे नहीं, घर में ही चलेगा।
rows.text: <laugh> Wah, Madam Judge! Today the serial is playing right at home, not on TV!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Wow, Madam Judge! Today the soap opera is playing right at home, not on TV!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: और मैं अदालत का सीसीटीवी इंचार्ज! मेरे कैमरे से कोई नहीं बच सकता।
rows.text: And I am Court CCTV in-charge! Nobody can escape from my camera!
rows.back_en: And I am in charge of the court CCTV! Nobody can escape from my camera!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: इस कैमरे में लेंस की जगह बोतल का ढक्कन लगा है।
rows.text: Arre, this camera has a bottle cap instead of a proper lens, yaar!
rows.back_en: Hey, this camera has a bottle cap instead of a proper lens, man!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: ढक्कन नहीं है, ज़ूम लेंस है!
rows.text: It's not a cap, it's a zoom lens!
rows.back_en: It's not a cap, it's a zoom lens!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: पापा, आप किसकी तरफ़ हैं? मम्मी की या दादी की?
rows.text: Papa, whose side are you on? Mummy's side or Dadi's side?
rows.back_en: Dad, whose side are you on? Mom's side or Grandma's side?

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: मैं? मैं स्विट्ज़रलैंड हूँ! बिल्कुल बीच में, पूरा न्यूट्रल!
rows.text: Me? I am Switzerland only! Exactly in the middle, totally neutral!
rows.back_en: Me? I'm Switzerland! Right in the middle, totally neutral!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: तो न्यूट्रल जी, गवाह के कटघरे से हटिए। केस शुरू होता है।
rows.text: Then Mister Neutral, step away from the witness box. The case begins now.
rows.back_en: Then Mr. Neutral, step away from the witness stand. The case begins now.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: मुक़दमा नंबर एक। कमला देवी बनाम सुनीता। जुर्म, तीस साल से सँभाली हुई अचार की बरनी ग़ायब करना।
rows.text: Case number one. Kamla Devi versus Sunita. Crime: vanishing a pickle jar kept safely for thirty whole years.
rows.back_en: Case number one. Kamla Devi versus Sunita. Crime: making a pickle jar disappear that was kept safely for thirty whole years.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: वो सिर्फ़ बरनी नहीं थी, जज साहिबा। <short pause> उसमें इस घर का स्वाद था।
rows.text: It wasn't just a jar, Madam Judge. <short pause> The taste of this entire house was in it.
rows.back_en: It wasn't just a jar, Madam Judge. <short pause> The flavor of this entire household was in it.

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: और मैं बेक़सूर हूँ, जज साहिबा। सबूत है तो सबूत लाइए।
rows.text: And I am innocent, Madam Judge. If there is proof, then bring the proof!
rows.back_en: And I am innocent, Madam Judge. If there is proof, then bring the proof!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: ठीक है। पहले शिकायत करने वाली बोलेंगी। दादी, बताइए कल रात क्या हुआ।
rows.text: Okay. The complainant will speak first. Dadi, tell us what happened last night.
rows.back_en: Okay. The complainant will speak first. Grandma, tell us what happened last night.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: कल रात मैं रसोई में थी। तभी ये आई, और मेरी बरनी को ऐसे घूरा, जैसे सीरियल की खलनायिका।
rows.text: Last night I was in the kitchen. Then she entered, and glared at my jar like a daily soap villain vamp!
rows.back_en: Last night I was in the kitchen. Then she walked in, and glared at my jar like a soap opera villainess!

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Kamla's version
rows.text: Kamla's version
rows.back_en: Kamla's version

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: <laugh> ये पुरानी बरनी... इसे तो मैं फेंक दूँगी!
rows.text: <laugh> This old useless jar... I will throw it away!
rows.back_en: <laugh> This useless old jar... I'm going to throw it away!

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: ऑब्जेक्शन! <gasp> मैं ऐसे कब हँसती हूँ? और रसोई में बिजली कौन कड़काता है?
rows.text: Objection! <gasp> When do I ever laugh like that? And who makes lightning thunder in the kitchen?
rows.back_en: Objection! <gasp> When do I ever laugh like that? And who brings thunder and lightning into the kitchen?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: <laugh> ऑब्जेक्शन मंज़ूर। दादी, बिजली हटाइए, सच बताइए।
rows.text: <laugh> Objection sustained. Dadi, remove the lightning and tell the real truth.
rows.back_en: <laugh> Objection sustained. Grandma, drop the lightning and tell the real truth.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <laugh> अच्छा, बिजली नहीं कड़की थी। पर इसने कहा था, ये बरनी बदल दो।
rows.text: <laugh> Okay, lightning didn't strike. But she did say, change this pickle jar!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Okay, lightning didn't strike. But she did say, replace this pickle jar!

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: मैंने कहा था इसमें दरार है, नीचे से तेल रिस रहा है। वो बात अलग है!
rows.text: I said it has a crack and oil is leaking from the bottom! That is completely different!
rows.back_en: I said it has a crack and oil is leaking from the bottom! That is completely different!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: और मैंने कहा था, ये बरनी इस घर में तुमसे पहले आई थी। वो बात भी अलग है।
rows.text: And I said this jar arrived in this house before you did. That is also completely different.
rows.back_en: And I said this jar arrived in this house before you did. That is also completely different.

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: <laugh> दोनों की बात अलग-अलग है, तो झगड़ा एक क्यों है?
rows.text: <laugh> If both things are different-different, then why is the fight the same one?
rows.back_en: <laugh> If both things are completely different, then why is the fight the exact same?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: अगली गवाह, नेहा बुआ! कटघरे में आइए।
rows.text: Next witness, Neha Bua! Come into the witness box!
rows.back_en: Next witness, Aunt Neha! Step into the witness stand!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: आ गई! दोस्तों, अब आपकी नेहा गवाही देगी। लाइक करते रहिए!
rows.text: Present! Guys, now your Neha will give witness testimony. Keep on liking, na!
rows.back_en: Present! Guys, now your Neha will give witness testimony. Keep on liking, okay?

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: कल रात दस बजे मैंने कुछ ऐसा देखा... <short pause> जो किसी सीरियल में भी नहीं होता।
rows.text: Last night at ten o'clock I saw something... <short pause> which never even happens in TV serials, yaar!
rows.back_en: Last night at ten o'clock I saw something... <short pause> that never even happens in TV dramas, guys!

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Neha's version
rows.text: Neha's version
rows.back_en: Neha's version

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: भाभी चुपके से एक बड़ा डिब्बा लेकर आईं। इधर देखा, उधर देखा, और अलमारी में छिपा दिया!
rows.text: Bhabhi quietly sneaked in with a huge box. Looked here, looked there, and hid it inside the cupboard!
rows.back_en: Sister-in-law quietly snuck in with a huge box. Looked this way, looked that way, and hid it inside the cupboard!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: और ये रहा सबूत! वही डिब्बा, जो अलमारी से बरामद हुआ।
rows.text: And arre, here is the proof! The very same box recovered from the cupboard!
rows.back_en: And look, here is the proof! The exact same box recovered from the cupboard!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <gasp> नई बरनी? बिल्कुल मेरी जैसी!
rows.text: <gasp> A brand-new jar? Same to same like mine!
rows.back_en: <gasp> A brand-new jar? Exactly identical to mine!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: <gasp> मतलब असली की जगह नकली रख दी! ये तो फ़िल्मों वाला खेल है!
rows.text: <gasp> Meaning fake replaced the real one! This is total Bollywood drama!
rows.back_en: <gasp> Meaning a fake replaced the real one! This is total Bollywood drama!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: मम्मी, ये बरनी कहाँ से आई?
rows.text: Mummy, where did this new jar come from?
rows.back_en: Mom, where did this new jar come from?

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: <short pause> हाँ, मैंने मँगवाई थी। ऑनलाइन। पुरानी वाली की दरार देखकर।
rows.text: <short pause> Yes, I had ordered it online. Seeing the crack on the old one.
rows.back_en: <short pause> Yes, I had ordered it online after seeing the crack on the old one.

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: पर पुरानी मैंने नहीं फेंकी, जज साहिबा। सोचा था चुपके से अचार बदल दूँगी, माँजी को पता भी नहीं चलेगा।
rows.text: But I didn't throw the old one, Madam Judge! I thought I'd quietly swap the pickle, Maa-ji wouldn't even notice.
rows.back_en: But I didn't throw away the old one, Madam Judge! I thought I'd quietly switch the pickle, and Mother wouldn't even notice.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <sigh> पता भी नहीं चलेगा? <short pause> तीस साल की यादें अब ऑनलाइन मिलती हैं?
rows.text: <sigh> Wouldn't even notice? <short pause> Do thirty years of memories come online now?
rows.back_en: <sigh> Wouldn't even notice? <short pause> Do thirty years of memories come online now?

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: दोस्तों, कमेंट में बताइए, भाभी दोषी हैं या नहीं!
rows.text: Guys, tell me in the comments, is Bhabhi guilty or not, na?
rows.back_en: Guys, tell me in the comments, is my sister-in-law guilty or not?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: अगले गवाह, पापा! भागने की कोशिश मत कीजिए।
rows.text: Next witness, Papa! Do not try to run away now.
rows.back_en: Next witness, Dad! Don't try to run away now.

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <laugh> मैं तो बस पानी पीने जा रहा था।
rows.text: <laugh> I was just going to drink water only.
rows.back_en: <laugh> I was just going to get some water.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: कल रात आपने क्या देखा?
rows.text: What did you see last night, Papa?
rows.back_en: What did you see last night, Dad?

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: मैंने देखा कि इस घर में सब एक-दूसरे से बहुत प्यार करते हैं।
rows.text: I saw that everyone in this house loves each other so much only.
rows.back_en: I saw that everyone in this house just loves each other so much.

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Mahesh's version
rows.text: Mahesh's version
rows.back_en: Mahesh's version

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: माँ सुनीता की तारीफ़ कर रही थीं, सुनीता माँ की। और मैं बीच में हीरो की तरह खड़ा था।
rows.text: Ma was praising Sunita, Sunita was praising Ma. And I was standing in the middle like a hero itself!
rows.back_en: Mom was praising Sunita, Sunita was praising Mom. And I was standing in the middle like a hero myself!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: भैया, कल रात तो आप नौ बजे से खर्राटे ले रहे थे।
rows.text: Arre Bhaiya, you were snoring loudly since nine o'clock last night!
rows.back_en: Hey Brother, you were snoring loudly since nine o'clock last night!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: और हीरो जी ने कल रात अपने लिए चाय तक नहीं बनाई।
rows.text: And Mister Hero didn't even make tea for himself last night.
rows.back_en: And Mr. Hero didn't even make tea for himself last night.

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <gasp> खर्राटे भी तो शांति का संदेश हैं! मैं किसी की तरफ़ नहीं हूँ!
rows.text: <gasp> Snoring is also a message of peace, no? I am not taking anyone's side!
rows.back_en: <gasp> Snoring is also a message of peace, isn't it? I'm not taking anyone's side!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: <sigh> गवाह बेकार है। जाइए, स्विट्ज़रलैंड जी।
rows.text: <sigh> Useless witness. Please go, Mister Switzerland.
rows.back_en: <sigh> Useless witness. Please step down, Mr. Switzerland.

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: जज दीदी! असली सबूत तो मेरे सीसीटीवी में है! रात दो बजे की रिकॉर्डिंग!
rows.text: Judge Didi! The real proof is in my CCTV! Two o'clock recording in the night!
rows.back_en: Judge Sister! The real proof is on my CCTV! The two o'clock recording in the middle of the night!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: <gasp> तू रात को दो बजे जाग रहा था?
rows.text: <gasp> You were awake at two o'clock at night?
rows.back_en: <gasp> You were awake at two o'clock in the morning?

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: <laugh> सू-सू आई थी। पर मेरा कैमरा हमेशा तैयार रहता है!
rows.text: <laugh> Had to go pee-pee. But my camera is always fully ready!
rows.back_en: <laugh> I had to pee. But my camera is always completely ready!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: <laugh> जज साहिबा, गवाह की सू-सू भी रिकॉर्ड में लिख लीजिए!
rows.text: <laugh> Madam Judge, please write the witness's pee-pee into the court record na!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Madam Judge, please enter the witness's pee into the court record!

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Golu's CCTV
rows.text: Golu's CCTV
rows.back_en: Golu's CCTV

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: अँधेरा था। फिर आया एक भूत! सफ़ेद कपड़े, धीरे-धीरे क़दम, ठक, ठक, ठक!
rows.text: It was dark. Then came a ghost! White clothes, slow-slow footsteps, thud, thud, thud!
rows.back_en: It was dark. Then came a ghost! White clothes, very slow footsteps, thud, thud, thud!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: <gasp> भूत ने बरनी उठाई और ग़ायब! मैं डर के रज़ाई में घुस गया!
rows.text: <gasp> The ghost took the jar and vanished! I hid inside my blanket in fear!
rows.back_en: <gasp> The ghost took the jar and vanished! I hid under my blanket in fear!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: भूत? <gasp> घर में भूत? दोस्तों, ये तो वायरल हो जाएगा!
rows.text: Ghost? <gasp> Ghost in the house? Guys, this will go totally viral, yaar!
rows.back_en: A ghost? <gasp> A ghost in the house? Guys, this is going to go completely viral!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: रुको। ठक, ठक, ठक? भूत के पास छड़ी थी?
rows.text: Wait. Thud, thud, thud? Did the ghost have a walking stick?
rows.back_en: Wait. Thud, thud, thud? Did the ghost have a cane?

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <laugh> आज पंखा कितना धीरे चल रहा है ना...
rows.text: <laugh> Today the fan is running so slowly, no...
rows.back_en: <laugh> The fan is running so slowly today, isn't it...

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: <gasp> अम्माजी... आप?
rows.text: <gasp> Ammaji... you?
rows.back_en: <gasp> Grandma... you?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: बड़ी दादी, आप सीनियर सिटीज़न हैं। आप अपनी कुर्सी से ही गवाही दीजिए।
rows.text: Badi Dadi, you are a senior citizen. You can give testimony from your chair itself.
rows.back_en: Great-grandmother, you are a senior citizen. You can give your testimony right from your chair.

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: हाँ बिटिया, बरनी मैंने उठाई थी। <short pause> उसकी दरार रोज़ बढ़ रही थी।
rows.text: Yes child, I took the pickle jar. <short pause> Its crack was growing bigger every day.
rows.back_en: Yes, child, I took the pickle jar. <short pause> Its crack was growing bigger every day.

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: सोचा, किसी दिन कमला के हाथ में ही फट गई तो? इसलिए आँगन में तुलसी के पीछे छिपा दी।
rows.text: I thought, what if it breaks in Kamla's hands? So I hid it behind the Tulsi in the courtyard.
rows.back_en: I thought, what if it breaks in Kamla's hands? So I hid it behind the Tulsi plant in the courtyard.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: तो आपने मुझसे कहा क्यों नहीं, अम्माजी? <short pause> मैं सुबह से सुनीता पर चिल्ला रही हूँ!
rows.text: Then why didn't you tell me, Ammaji? <short pause> I've been screaming at Sunita since morning!
rows.back_en: Then why didn't you tell me, Mother? <short pause> I've been yelling at Sunita since morning!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: डर गई थी, कमला। <short pause> इस उम्र में भी एक बरनी से डर लगता है।
rows.text: I got scared, Kamla. <short pause> Even at this age, I was terrified of a jar.
rows.back_en: I got scared, Kamla. <short pause> Even at this age, I was terrified of a jar.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: सबूत अदालत में पेश किया जाए!
rows.text: Present the evidence before the court!
rows.back_en: Present the evidence before the court!

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: मैं लाती हूँ, जज साहिबा।
rows.text: I will bring it, Madam Judge.
rows.back_en: I will bring it, Madam Judge.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <sigh> तीस साल पहले, जिस दिन अम्माजी ने मुझे रसोई सौंपी, ये बरनी मेरे हाथ में दी थी।
rows.text: <sigh> Thirty years ago, the day Ammaji handed over the kitchen, she placed this jar in my hands.
rows.back_en: <sigh> Thirty years ago, the day Mother handed over the kitchen, she placed this jar in my hands.

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Thirty years ago
rows.text: Thirty years ago
rows.back_en: Thirty years ago

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: आज से ये बरनी तेरी। ये इस घर की इज़्ज़त है। टूटी, तो समझ घर टूटा।
rows.text: From today this jar is yours. It's the honour of this home. If it breaks, our home breaks.
rows.back_en: From today, this jar is yours. It's the honor of this home. If it breaks, our home breaks.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: दस साल मैं इस घर में मेहमान जैसी रही थी। <sigh> उस दिन पहली बार लगा, मैं इस घर की हूँ।
rows.text: For ten years I lived like a guest in this house. <sigh> That day, for the first time, I felt I belonged.
rows.back_en: For ten years I lived like a guest in this house. <sigh> That day, for the first time, I felt like I belonged.

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: दादी, तीस साल पहले भी आप बिल्कुल ऐसी ही दिखती थीं?
rows.text: Dadi, did you look same to same like this thirty years ago too?
rows.back_en: Grandma, did you look exactly like this thirty years ago too?

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: <laugh> गोलू, याद में सब लोग आज वाले चेहरे में ही आते हैं।
rows.text: <laugh> Golu, in memories everyone appears in today's faces only, na!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Golu, in memories everyone appears with their faces from today, don't they!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: तीस साल इसे बच्चे की तरह सँभाला। इसी के साथ तो मुझे अपनापन मिला था।
rows.text: Looked after it like a child for thirty years. With this jar, I found where I belonged.
rows.back_en: I looked after it like a child for thirty years. With this jar, I found where I belonged.

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: माँजी... <short pause> मुझे नहीं पता था। मैं तो बस एक बरनी बदल रही थी।
rows.text: Maa-ji... <short pause> I had no idea. I was simply trying to replace a jar.
rows.back_en: Mother... <short pause> I had no idea. I was simply trying to replace a jar.

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: नहीं, कमला। अब पूरा सच सुन ले।
rows.text: No, Kamla. Now listen to the whole truth.
rows.back_en: No, Kamla. Now listen to the whole truth.

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <short pause> वो बरनी असली नहीं है।
rows.text: <short pause> That jar is not the original.
rows.back_en: <short pause> That jar is not the original.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <gasp> क्या मतलब, अम्माजी?
rows.text: <gasp> What do you mean, Ammaji?
rows.back_en: <gasp> What do you mean, Mother?

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: साठ साल पहले मैं भी नई बहू थी। <sigh> मेरी सास की असली बरनी मेरे हाथ से गिरी और टूट गई।
rows.text: Sixty years ago I was also a new bride. <sigh> My mother-in-law's real jar slipped from my hands and broke!
rows.back_en: Sixty years ago I was also a new bride. <sigh> My mother-in-law's real jar slipped from my hands and broke!

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Sixty years ago
rows.text: Sixty years ago
rows.back_en: Sixty years ago

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: मैं डर से काँप गई। उसी दोपहर बाज़ार गई, हूबहू वैसी बरनी ख़रीदी, अचार भरा, और ताक पर रख दी।
rows.text: I was shaking with fear. That afternoon I ran to the market, bought the exact same jar, filled the pickle, and put it back!
rows.back_en: I was trembling with fear. That afternoon I ran to the market, bought the exact same jar, filled it with pickle, and put it back!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <laugh> और मेरी सास को आख़िर तक पता ही नहीं चला।
rows.text: <laugh> And till the very end, my mother-in-law never found out!
rows.back_en: <laugh> And until the very end, my mother-in-law never found out!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: तो जिसे मैं तीस साल से पूज रही थी... <short pause> वो बाज़ार की बरनी है?
rows.text: So the jar I worshipped for thirty years... <short pause> is just from the local market?
rows.back_en: So the jar I worshipped for thirty years... <short pause> is just from the local market?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: <gasp> नीचे लिखा है, खुर्जा बाज़ार, दो रुपये!
rows.text: <gasp> Written at the bottom: Khurja Bazaar, two rupees!
rows.back_en: <gasp> Written at the bottom: Khurja Market, two rupees!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: <laugh> दो रुपये की बरनी पर तीन पीढ़ियों का झगड़ा!
rows.text: <laugh> Three whole generations fighting over a two-rupee jar, yaar!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Three whole generations fighting over a two-rupee jar, guys!

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <gasp> मतलब मैं बचपन से बाज़ार वाला अचार खा रहा हूँ?
rows.text: <gasp> Meaning since childhood itself I am eating bazaar pickle only?
rows.back_en: <gasp> You mean ever since childhood I've been eating market pickle all along?

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <sigh> मैंने कभी अपनी सास से नहीं पूछा कि एक बरनी पर इतना ग़ुस्सा क्यों। <short pause> बस वही डर तुझे थमा दिया।
rows.text: <sigh> I never asked my mother-in-law why so much anger over a jar. <short pause> Just passed that fear on to you.
rows.back_en: <sigh> I never asked my mother-in-law why there was so much anger over a jar. <short pause> I just passed that fear on to you.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: और मैंने कभी आपसे नहीं पूछा कि आप ये अचार ख़ुद कभी खाती क्यों नहीं।
rows.text: And I never asked you either, why you yourself never ate this pickle.
rows.back_en: And I never asked you either why you never ate this pickle yourself.

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <laugh> क्योंकि हर कौर में अपनी चोरी याद आती थी!
rows.text: <laugh> Because every single bite reminded me of my secret theft!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Because every single bite reminded me of my secret theft!

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: अदालत फ़ैसला सुनाती है। दादी दोषी हैं। मम्मी भी दोषी हैं। दोनों ने एक ही जुर्म किया है।
rows.text: Court delivers the verdict. Dadi is guilty. Mummy is also guilty. Both committed the exact same crime!
rows.back_en: The court delivers the verdict. Grandma is guilty. Mom is also guilty. Both committed the exact same crime!

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: <gasp> दोनों? कौन-सा जुर्म, जज साहिबा?
rows.text: <gasp> Both? Which crime, Madam Judge?
rows.back_en: <gasp> Both? Which crime, Madam Judge?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: आपने एक-दूसरे से कभी "क्यों" नहीं पूछा।
rows.text: You people never asked each other "why".
rows.back_en: You people never asked each other "why".

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: दादी ने नहीं पूछा कि मम्मी बरनी के पीछे क्यों पड़ी हैं। मम्मी ने नहीं पूछा कि दादी के लिए वो बरनी इतनी ज़रूरी क्यों है।
rows.text: Dadi never asked why Mummy wanted to change the jar. And Mummy never asked why that jar was so precious to Dadi.
rows.back_en: Grandma never asked why Mom wanted to change the jar. And Mom never asked why that jar was so precious to Grandma.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: और बड़ी दादी साठ साल चुप रहीं। सज़ा सबको मिलेगी!
rows.text: And Badi Dadi stayed silent for sixty years. Everyone gets punishment!
rows.back_en: And Great-grandmother stayed silent for sixty years. Everyone gets punished!

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <sigh> शुक्र है, मैं तो बच गया।
rows.text: <sigh> Thank God, I am saved only.
rows.back_en: <sigh> Thank God, at least I am spared.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: पापा, चुप रहना भी जुर्म है। अचार के सारे आम आप काटेंगे।
rows.text: Papa, staying quiet is also a crime. You will chop all the mangoes for the pickle!
rows.back_en: Dad, staying quiet is also a crime. You will chop all the mangoes for the pickle!

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: <gasp> पूरे दस किलो?
rows.text: <gasp> Whole ten kilos, is it?
rows.back_en: <gasp> A whole ten kilos?

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: और दादी और मम्मी मिलकर नया अचार डालेंगी, नई बरनी में। रोज़ एक बार एक-दूसरे से पूछेंगी, "क्यों?"
rows.text: And Dadi and Mummy together will make new pickle in the new jar. Once every day, they will ask each other, "Why?"
rows.back_en: And Grandma and Mom together will make new pickle in the new jar. Once every day, they will ask each other, "Why?"

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: सुनीता, तूने नई बरनी क्यों मँगवाई थी?
rows.text: Sunita, why did you order that new jar, beta?
rows.back_en: Sunita, why did you order that new jar, dear?

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: क्योंकि आपको उस बरनी से प्यार है, माँजी। मैं नहीं चाहती थी कि वो आपके हाथ में टूटे।
rows.text: Because you love that jar so much, Maa-ji. I just didn't want it breaking in your own hands.
rows.back_en: Because you love that jar so much, Mother. I just didn't want it breaking in your own hands.

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.hi: और आप? आपको वो इतनी प्यारी क्यों थी?
rows.text: And what about you? Why was it so dear to you?
rows.back_en: And what about you? Why was it so dear to you?

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: क्योंकि उसने मुझे इस घर का बनाया था।
rows.text: Because it made me feel part of this family.
rows.back_en: Because it made me feel like part of this family.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: आज से नई बरनी हम दोनों की। और टूट भी गई, तो नई ले आएँगे। घर नहीं टूटेगा।
rows.text: From today, the new jar belongs to both of us. And even if it breaks, we will get another. The home won't break!
rows.back_en: From today, the new jar belongs to both of us. And even if it breaks, we will get another. The home won't break!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <sigh> साठ साल बाद आज मन हल्का हुआ।
rows.text: <sigh> After sixty years, my heart feels light today.
rows.back_en: <sigh> After sixty years, my heart feels light today.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: अदालत बर्ख़ास्त!
rows.text: Court is adjourned!
rows.back_en: Court is adjourned!

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: सरसों का तेल पहले गरम करना, फिर ठंडा। जल्दी मत करना।
rows.text: Heat mustard oil first, then let it cool down. Don't rush into it.
rows.back_en: Heat the mustard oil first, then let it cool down. Don't rush it.

rows.speaker: SUNITA
rows.text: Why, Maa-ji?
rows.back_en: Why, Mother?

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <laugh> वाह! आज का पहला "क्यों"! क्योंकि गरम तेल में मसाला जल जाता है।
rows.text: <laugh> Wah! Today's first "why"! Because in smoking hot oil, spices get burnt!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Wow! Today's first "why"! Because in smoking hot oil, spices get burnt!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: नमक थोड़ा ज़्यादा डालना। <short pause> मेरी सास भी ज़्यादा डालती थीं।
rows.text: Add a little extra salt. <short pause> My mother-in-law also used to put extra.
rows.back_en: Add a little extra salt. <short pause> My mother-in-law also used to add extra.

rows.speaker: KAMLA
rows.hi: <laugh> अम्माजी, अब आपकी सास की हर बात पर पहले पूछूँगी, क्यों?
rows.text: <laugh> Ammaji, now for every word of your mother-in-law, first I'll ask: why?
rows.back_en: <laugh> Grandmother, now for every word from your mother-in-law, first I'll ask: why?

rows.speaker: MAHESH
rows.hi: और आज मैंने भी पहली बार एक साइड चुनी है। अचार की साइड!
rows.text: And today for the first time, I also picked a side! Pickle's side only!
rows.back_en: And today for the first time, I also picked a side! Just the pickle's side!

rows.speaker: NEHA
rows.hi: दोस्तों, सास-बहू महायुद्ध, एपिसोड टू! अचार महामिलन!
rows.text: Friends, mother-in-law daughter-in-law war, episode two! The Great Pickle Reunion, yaar!
rows.back_en: Friends, mother-in-law versus daughter-in-law war, episode two! The Great Pickle Reunion, guys!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: और सीसीटीवी में सब रिकॉर्ड हो रहा है!
rows.text: And everything is getting recorded on CCTV!
rows.back_en: And everything is being recorded on CCTV!

rows.speaker: AMMAJI
rows.hi: <gasp> इस बार मैंने नहीं तोड़ी! मेरे हाथ तो यहाँ हैं!
rows.text: <gasp> I didn't break it this time! See, both my hands are right here!
rows.back_en: <gasp> I didn't break it this time! See, both my hands are right here!

rows.speaker: GOLU
rows.hi: <laugh> वो... सीसीटीवी अभी बंद था।
rows.text: <laugh> Umm... CCTV was switched off right now.
rows.back_en: <laugh> Umm... the CCTV was turned off just now.

rows.speaker: CHINKI
rows.hi: अदालत फिर से शुरू!
rows.text: Court is back in session!
rows.back_en: Court is back in session!

rows.speaker: CARD
rows.hi: Before you blame, ask "why".
rows.text: Before you blame, ask "why".
rows.back_en: Before you blame, ask "why".
